data.long_meaning: Avish is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘विश्व’ (Vishv) which means ‘all, universally’. The prefix ‘अव-’ (Av-) means ‘God’ or ‘Lord’, so Avish means ‘God is abundant’. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
